Sarah: Quick async checkpoint on Optimize toolkit delivery — PR for quant recs merged (D3892) but nightly regression alert on 7B int8 microbenchmarks. Need clear owners for rollout and a small mitigation plan.

Jake: Thanks. Which tests failed? link to CI? @ops-bot can you paste the alert?

ops-bot: [ALERT] nightly-regression: llm-bench/7b_int8_latency increased ~12% vs baseline. Artifact: s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/199999/llm-7b-int8.log

Priya: Oof. I saw higher p99 in the canary yesterday on hosts in eu-west1. Could be kernel selection fallback for the quantized path.

Luis: I'll triage kernel logs. Assigning to @Tom for rollout decision. Tom, do we pause canary or rollforward with a patch?

Tom: Pause canary for 7B-int8, roll back to 7B-fp16 in dedicated pools. I'll open rollback PR and a short postmortem checklist. ETA for rollback PR: ~30m.

Sarah: Thanks. Owners: Tom -> rollback PR, Luis -> kernel triage, Priya -> perf benchmarks to reproduce locally, Jake -> coordinate Dedicated routing change and update the rollout doc. I'll update the Optimize delivery page with status.

Priya: Repro steps I used: run `make perf-7b INT8=1 SEQ=512 BATCH=1` then compare p99. Logs attached. Will try with the new kernel flags.

Jake: Note: Need to inform product about possible delay in optimized quant rollout. I'll ping PMs after rollback completes.

Tom: PR opened D3901, rolling back canary on eu-west1 now. Will post when done.

ops-bot: [ACTION] Rollback initiated by Tom. Change set: dedicated-routing -> fp16-fallback. Tracking ticket: #inc-1999

Sarah: Great. Follow-ups: Luis to post triage summary here, Priya to run regression A/B on canary once kernel fix is in, Jake to update release timeline. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Luis: Will post triage summary by EOD PST.

(End of thread)
